$comment: English texts of data/skills.json, by the skill's id (src/engine/overlay.js): the three paths of each class at class level 10, each with its skill. A path's name is also the name of the class's first evolution (data/evolutions.json), and the narrator's line skills-paths (data/en/tutorial.json) names each path exactly as it is written here: narrator.js finds the name in the line to move the camera to it. `style` is shown in capitals over the skill. In `effect`, {name%}, {name%.1}, {name pp}, {cooldown} and {critPower%} are filled with the skill's numbers by src/engine/skills.js (skillText); every number of turns, hits and points there is more than one. `stunLabel` stands on the card of the creature that loses its turn.

power-strike.name: Mighty Blow
power-strike.description: The warrior swings with all their might. A blow like this pierces even a thick hide.
power-strike.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage that ignores {armorIgnore%} of the target's armour.

wide-sweep.name: Wide Sweep
wide-sweep.description: The blade cuts a wide arc and reaches everyone who stands before it.
wide-sweep.effect: Attacks every enemy for {power%} damage. You may miss. When the target is a single enemy – the skill deals {single%} damage.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.description: When things turn dangerous, the warrior braces behind the shield and does not take a single step back.
unyielding.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, recovers {heal%} of max HP and gains {armor%} more armour for {turns} of their own turns.

aimed-shot.name: True Shot
aimed-shot.description: The archer holds their breath and aims at an unguarded spot.
aimed-shot.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage that cannot be dodged. With it, the chance of a critical hit rises by {critBonus pp}.

arrow-rain.name: Hail of Arrows
arrow-rain.description: Several arrows loosed one after another, falling upon the foes.
arrow-rain.effect: Deals {power%} damage to all foes, with a chance to miss. Used on a single enemy, it deals {single%} damage.

pinning-shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning-shot.description: The arrow nails the enemy's foot to the ground before it can move.
pinning-shot.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage. The enemy hit loses its next turn.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: The mage gathers embers in their hands and hurls them at the enemy.
fireball.effect: A fire spell dealing {power%} damage. The target has a {dotChance%} chance of Burn: for {dotTicks} of its turns it loses {dotPower%} of the spell's damage each turn.

frost-gust.name: Frost Gust
frost-gust.description: An icy wind lashes every enemy and slows their every move.
frost-gust.effect: A frost spell on all enemies deals {power%} damage. Every enemy hit is slowed by {slow%}.

mana-shield.name: Mana Shield
mana-shield.description: The mage surrounds themselves with a magic shield built upon their own mana.
mana-shield.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, uses {pool%} of max mana and turns it into a shield that stops damage equal to {ratio%} of the mana taken. The shield takes blows until it is spent.

prayer-of-health.name: Prayer for Health
prayer-of-health.description: The cleric whispers a prayer, and the wounds begin to close.
prayer-of-health.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, heals {heal%.1} of max HP, plus 1 HP for every {wisdomPerHp} points of Wisdom.

exorcism.name: Exorcism
exorcism.description: The cleric speaks the words of exorcism and lashes every enemy with the sacred element.
exorcism.effect: Exorcism lashes every enemy, dealing {power%} sacred damage. Against a single target – it deals {single%} damage. Every enemy hit has a {stunChance%} chance of paralysis and then loses its next turn.

blessing.name: Blessing
blessing.description: The cleric traces a holy sign over themselves and their companions. Damage taken falls, and damage dealt – rises.
blessing.effect: At the start of a fight, until its end: armour and resistances +{armor%}, damage +{damage%}. In a party fight the bonus grows and is shared out.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: The Shadow vanishes from the enemy's sight and strikes where it is least expected.
backstab.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage, always critical ({critPower%} in all), at the enemy standing furthest back. Works on the first turn of a fight, then at most once every {cooldown} turns.

poisoned-blade.name: Poisoned Blade
poisoned-blade.description: The Shadow smears the blade with viper venom. Every scratch burns from within.
poisoned-blade.effect: At the start of a fight, until its end: every blow has a {dotChance%} chance of Poison. For {dotTicks} of its turns, a poisoned enemy loses {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn.

shadow-dance.name: Shadow Dance
shadow-dance.description: The Shadow blurs in motion. Enemy blows cut only air.
shadow-dance.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}: for the next {hits} enemy blows, dodge rises by {dodge pp}. Each dodge brings a counter dealing {counter%} damage.
